exactStaticRouteUniverse.enumeration: AST over every mounted deployed API router decorator without importing the application

authorityBoundary.generalAuthModel: one bearer session gate for all non-public routes; no route roles/scopes
authorityBoundary.bootstrapRisk: After each fresh process start the first loopback caller can claim the public setup endpoint and obtain an all-control-plane bearer.

criticalFindings: ApplyGate accepts any non-empty approvalPromptId and testRunResultId without resolving ownership, freshness, approval decision or passed test evidence; gateId, backupPlanId and applyPackageId are not authoritative.
The same bearer can enable controlled apply, register and enable a writable workspace, and submit an apply; rollback also accepts a presence-only approvalPromptId.
Security password/configured state is process-memory only while setup and unlock are public; live read-only status was protected but configured:false.
Public dashboard safety labels claim no host writes/real patch apply while the deployed real-apply writer is mounted.
Path validation and later file replacement/removal are not inode/dirfd bound, leaving an authenticated TOCTOU/symlink risk within writable ancestors.

admin.reason: A separate loopback LUMI dashboard exists, but it lacks durable operator identity, scoped roles and four-eyes approval.

api.reason: All 203 routes are mounted behind a coarse bearer gate, with two narrow KAIROS service exceptions.

limitations: Static source proves capability presence, not adversarial acceptance of every gate and effect.
The public status/dashboard GETs prove current bootstrap state only; no setup, unlock, authenticated or mutating call was made.
No money/ACL writer, provider call, shell execution or plaintext-secret disclosure was observed.

independentReviews.finding: Exact route inventory and live public status confirm broad control authority plus claimable bootstrap.
Presence-only apply evidence, shared bearer authority, restart bootstrap and file-write TOCTOU violate the advisory boundary.

nextCanonicalItem: Classify KAIROS_AUTONOMOUS_TRADE_CONTROL across all six surfaces and verify its execution authority read-only.
